title: Meeting Rooms
prompt:
Given meeting time `intervals`, return whether a single person could attend all of them (no two overlap). Touching endpoints like `[1,3]`,`[3,5]` are fine.

**Example**: `[[0,30],[5,10],[15,20]]` → `false`.

Sort by start; any overlap between consecutive meetings makes it impossible.
hints: A conflict exists iff some meeting starts before the previous one ends.
Use strict `<` so touching endpoints don't count as overlap.

solution.explanation: After sorting by start, if a meeting conflicts with any earlier meeting, it conflicts with the one right before it, so one linear pass is enough. The strict `<` treats back-to-back meetings (end == next start) as compatible. O(n log n) time, O(1) extra space.
